generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
No Joint Venture/consortium Tenders arepermissible.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

The tenderer is required to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance to the last date and time for receipt of tenders. Rates shall be quoted in price schedule in the website itself.
The tender shall be valid for 180 days from the date of submission of Bid.
The tender document is part and parcel of the agreement.
Conditional tenders are liable for rejection.
The tenderer shall comply all the GST requirements.

The contractor shall quote his rates inclusive of PF as per the applicable rate as issued by the PF department from time to time and if any variation occurs enforced by Govt. it shall be paid/refunded by/to the Corporation against documentary evidence.

The tenderer shall obtain insurance coverage for all the workers deployed for this work.

The bidder shall quote his rates exclusive of GST but inclusive of all applicable taxes, levies, duties and cess, building worker welfare cess (if applicable) etc., as per the latest GOK and Government of India prevailing as on the date of NIT.
All labourers Police verification is to be carried out by the contractor & same to Besubmitted for gate passes and cost is also to be borne by the contractor.
KPCL shall recover the Income Tax at the prevailing applicable rates.

The successful bidder should strictly adhere & ensure the minimum wages Act to the labours prevailing as per the Govt. rules & regulations. In case the dates notified for NIT are declared as holiday, the immediate next working day will be reckoned.
If the tenderer makes any alterations in the conditions of the contract or puts any condition of his own, such tenders are liable for rejection.

Further details of the work or any clarifications can be obtained from the office of the Executive Engineer (RTM), Raichur Thermal Power Station, Karnataka Power Corporation Ltd., Shaktinagar 584170, during officeHours. Mobile 9480682533.
Corrigendum/modification/corrections,if any,willbe publishedin the web site only.
Any variation in labour wages made by the Government from time to time shall be borne by the agency. Any claim towards this variation will not be entertained by KPCL

Aspiring bidders /Contractors who have not obtained the User ID and Password for participating in e-procurement in Karnataka Power Corporation Limited may approach and obtain the same from the website https://kppp.karnataka.gov.in

In case of death of a contractor after executing the agreement/commencement of the work, his legal heir (to be intimated at the time of execution of agreement by the successful contractor), if any eligible registered contractor and willing, can execute and complete the work at the accepted tender rates irrespective of the cost of the work after obtaining approval from competent authority.

The successful bidder has to furnish a e-Bank Guarantee/DD from a scheduled Bank towards Contract Performance Guarantee (CPG), for an amount equivalent to 5% of the contract value plus additional performance security for unbalanced tender with an appropriate validity period (i.e. Validity period is the Contract period and including work performance guarantee period) within 20 days from the date of Work Order (WO). The e-Bank Guarantee (e-BG) shall be furnished in the prescribed format only. The work Performance shall be of 12 Months after completing the work. The total contract period is 18 Months, 06 months completion period & 12 Months Guarantee performance period). The Contract Performance Guarantee (CPG) will be released only after the satisfactory completion of total contract and additional performance security for unbalanced tender shall be valid till completion of work.

The bidder should take into account the prevailing royalty charges while quoting their rates and submit the Material Dispatch Permit (MDP) receipt, if not submitted penalty shall be charged as per the joint secretary, Energy Department letter no. Energy 26 PPT 2022 Dtd:26.04.2022.

The successful bidder has to furnish the e-Bank Guarantee/DD from a Nationalized/Schedule bank towards additional security for unbalanced tender (i.e. difference of tendered amount and contract value). technicalCriterionList.description: The intending bidder should have satisfactorily completed (at least 90% of the contract value) as a prime contractor, atleast one Civil Construction work of value not less than Rs.217.455 Lakhs (Inclusive of GST) in the preceding five financial years i.e. (2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26). The Certificate to that extent shall be issued by the Competent Authority not below the rank of Chief Engineer in case of KPCL works and not below the rank of Executive Engineer/ Competent Authority in case of other Government organization is to be uploaded in the technical bid. (Work done of previous years shall be given a weight at10% per year to bring them to the present price level).

Tenderers who meet the specified minimum qualifying criteria, will only be qualified, if their available tender capacity is more than the total tender value. The available tender capacity will be calculated as under. Tender capacity: (A x N x 1.5 - B), where, A - Maximum value of works executed in any one year during the last five years (updated to 2026-27 price level) taking into account the completed as well as works in progress. N - Number of years prescribed for completion of the works for which Tenders are invited for 0.5 Years. B - Value at 2026-27 price level of existing commitments and ongoing works to be completed during the next 0.5 year period of completion of the works for which Tenders are invited.

The Intending bidder should have achieved at least in two financial years a minimum financial turnover of Rs. 869.82 Lakhs (Inclusive of GST)during the preceding fivefinancial years i.e. (2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25& 2025-26). The bidder shall submit certified copy of turnover or the Profit and Loss account certificate duly certified by the Chartered Accountant for the respective years & the same shall be uploaded along with the technical bid. (Financial turnover of previous years shall be given weight at 10% per year to bring them to the present price level).

technicalCriterionList.description: Any reputed individual/Company/firm having valid KPWD contractor registration certificate of Class II & above are eligible for participation in the tender for which supporting documents shall be uploaded and are eligible for participation for which scanned copy of the same shall be uploaded.
GST Registration certificate shall be uploaded.
Income Tax PAN shall be uploaded.

The bidder shall upload the self-declaration as I/we shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by KPCL or by any State Government/Government of India/ Union Territory. I/we declares that EMD has not been forfeited and None of my contracts have been terminated/foreclosed on account of default in KPCL or elsewhere during the past 3 (Three) years. My/our offer has no conditions contravening the commercial conditions of the bid. I/we have studied the site conditions, labour conditions and read the Bid documents and related matters carefully and diligently and that he has submitted the bid having studied understood and accepted the full implications of the agreement. I/we shall pay fair and reasonable wages, which shall not be less than the minimum wages fixed by GOK to the labours/workmen employed in the contract. I/we have accepted the condition that KPCL reserves the right to foreclose the contract at any point of time without assigning any reason. I/we accepted the condition that e-Bank Guarantee/DD from a Nationalized/Schedule bank towards additional security for unbalanced tender (i.e. difference of tendered amount and contract value) will be furnished, in case of successful bidder. If fails to furnish the same within stipulated period action may be initiated as per KPCL norms.

Liquid assets availability of credit facilities of not less than Rs. 2.17Crore Credit lines/letter of credit/certificates from Nationalized Banks/Scheduled Banks for meeting the fund requirement etc., shall be uploaded.

The intending bidder should have executed the work involving Reinforced Cement Concrete(RCC)of quantity not less than 1944.00 Cum in any one of the preceding five financial years i.e. (2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26). The certificate issued by the Competent Authority not below the rank of Chief Engineer in case of KPCL works and not below the rank of Executive Engineer and equivalent in case other Government Organizations is to be uploaded in the technical bid.

Each tenderer should further demonstrate availability by owning at least 50 percent of the required specified key and critical equipment for this work and the remaining 50 percent can be deployed on lease hire basis for all works provided, the relevant documents (Commitment agreements etc) for availability for this work are furnished. Availability by owning the following key and critical equipment for this work. Excavator Own 1 and Hire 1, Tipper Own 1 and Hire 1, Concrete mixer (Ajax) Own 1 and Hire 1, Water Tanker Own 1 and Hire 1. As a proof of this the intended bidder must upload the relevant documents like ownership document & for Lease/ Hire basis- relevant documents (commitment agreements etc., shall be scanned and uploaded).

itemList.description: Removal of Unserviceable Soil with Disposal upto a suitable distance as directed by the Engineer incharge of work

Earth work excavation for Foundation by mechanical means for all works & depth upto 3 m, as per drawing and technical specifications,including setting out, shoring, strutting, barricading, caution lights, including dressing of excavated surfaces, disposing off or levelling the excavated earth or sorting & stacking the selected earth for reuse near by to the dump yard and lift upto 1.5 m including cost of labour, tools, usage of machinery & other appurtenaces required to complete the work of machinery & other appurtenaces required to complete the work. 1.14.1 In all kinds of soils Depth upto 3 m
Providing rubble and sand filling in layers of 250 to 300 mm including cost of all materials,machinery, labour, watering, ramming and all other ancillary operations complete

Providing and laying in position Cement Concrete for all Sub structures of building, Irrigation works, Sub structure works of bridges, Drain works & other parallel works from 0.50m to 3.50 m height. The granite/trap/basalt crushed graded coarse aggregates and fine aggregates as per relevant IS Codes machine mixed with super plasticisers, laid in layers, well compacted using needle vibrators, providing weep holes wherever necessary, including all lead & lifts, cost of all materials of quality, confirming to the requirements of relevant IS codes, labour, Usage charges of machinery, curing and all other appurtenances required to complete the work as per technical specifications.Mix 1:2:4 (M15) Using 20 mm nominal size graded crushed coarse aggregates

Supplying, fitting and placing TMT FE 550 / 550D Steel Reinforcement including cost of all materials, machinery, labour, cleaning, straightening,cutting, bending, hooking, laping/welding joints, tying with binding wire / soft annealed steel wire and other ancilary operations complete as per drawing and technical specification

Cutting transverse contraction joints 3 to 4 mm wide and depth 60mm in concrete slab using concrete cutting machine with diamond studded saw within 4-8 hours of casting of bay / slab etc. complete including subsequent widening of the groove 8 to 10 mm. wide at top having depth of 15mm as directed by engineer incharge MORTH 602.6.3

Providing to contraction joints polysuphide sealent (Pouring grade) confirming to BS : 5212 - 1989 into sawed groove widened at top for sealent reservoir of specified size and shape as per detailed drawing including fixing Polyethylene foam backer rod of required diameter (approx. 25% larger than the initial 3 mm.to 4 mm. joint) overlaid with bond breaking tape as per detailed drawing. Item includes cleaning the joints with water jet / air compressor and allowing joint to become thoroughly dry before sealent is applied and applying primer. (A) Contraction and longitudinal joints (15 mm. deep x 8 mm.wide). MORTH 602.6.3
